sys_script_include.description: Implements extension point x_733168_aes.AESAnnouncementExtension Allows applications to customize or enrich Announcement DTOs returned by AESAnnouncementService without modifying the AES core implementation. Extensions receive the standard Announcement object, source GlideRecord, and query options, and must return the resulting Announcement object.
sys_script_include.name: AESAnnouncementExtension
